metadata.description: Claude Code mods from the AI PM workspace: a closing-time band, follow-up chips and a weekly focus pane.

plugins.name: end-of-work
plugins.description: A band above the prompt that warns you before your closing time and tells you how far past it you are.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Three follow-up chips above the prompt after every answer; click one to send it.

plugins.name: weekly-focus
plugins.description: A side pane with today's tasks (Todoist or tasks.md) and this week's priorities.
